body.x: FoldiMate unveiled its all-purpose robot that organizes laundry at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

This device quickly and consistently folds laundry like a pro. Therefore, it is not necessary for people directly and inconveniently to fold laundry and to store it. As clothes for people increase, this equipment can be considered to be a smart and necessary product when the amount of laundry and the clothes to be folded are increasing. The latest model was unveiled at CES 2018 and got a lot of attention.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
